crush: You had an Assamese crush. Your imagination heard that and immediately ordered a full romance arc. Pashu, it was a crush, not a green light for season two. ♡

letterPhoto.caption: my favourite person to be ridiculous with. ♡

letter: Okay, Pashu. Under all this highly professional bullying is a very simple thing: I absolutely adore you.
You’re my blood sister from another mother. Family, with slightly fewer shared relatives and significantly more opportunities to call you a cow.
I hope this year is kind to you. I hope you feel loved on the boring days, the messy days, and the days when your brain is just a cow standing in a field, buffering.
Whatever life does next, you have me. In your corner. On your team. Probably making a very unhelpful joke, but absolutely, completely there.
signature: All my love, your permanently assigned idiot. ♡
birthdayMessage: Here’s to more life, more laughter, and more reasons for me to say “Pashu, please.” Love you an unreasonable amount.
